items.question: 上个月的房费收入是多少
items.gold_sql:
SELECT SUM(sl.rooms * sl.nights * sl.unit_price) AS value
FROM stay_lines sl JOIN bookings b ON sl.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN hotels h ON b.hotel_id = h.hotel_id JOIN room_types rt ON sl.room_type_id = rt.room_type_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', b.checkin_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH)
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

items.question: 各房型毛利率
items.gold_sql:
SELECT rt.type_name AS room_type, ((SUM(sl.rooms * sl.nights * sl.unit_price)) - (SUM(sl.rooms * sl.nights * rt.room_cost))) / NULLIF((SUM(sl.rooms * sl.nights * sl.unit_price)), 0) AS value
FROM stay_lines sl JOIN bookings b ON sl.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN hotels h ON b.hotel_id = h.hotel_id JOIN room_types rt ON sl.room_type_id = rt.room_type_id
WHERE TRUE
GROUP BY rt.type_name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100
